memories: When implementing the Camera Coordinates Map, `player.cameraMap` should be resolved before `CAMERA_PRESETS` in `src/routine-camera.js`.

When adding WebGPU device lost safety checks in `src/routine-player.js`, ensure the checks for `!this.renderer.device` or `this.renderer.device.lost` are gated by `this.renderer.backendType !== 'webgl'`, otherwise WebGL tests will fail because WebGL has no `device`.
